job.command:
stardev
# Flatten data_to_jet/ into the job's working dir. cp data_to_jet/* . cp shared/* . # cp (not -r) skips subdirs -- hcal_gain_corrections/ needs its own # recursive copy to land flat where SetHcalRetroactiveGainCorr() expects it. cp -r data_to_jet/hcal_gain_corrections .
# Evenly split {{LISTFILE}} across NPROCESSES jobs (contiguous ranges, # first "remainder" jobs get one extra line). set NTOTAL = `wc -l < {{LISTFILE}}` set NJOBS = {{NPROCESSES}}
@ base = ${NTOTAL} / ${NJOBS} @ rem = ${NTOTAL} % ${NJOBS}
if ( ${JOBINDEX} < ${rem} ) then @ mycount = ${base} + 1 @ mystart = ${JOBINDEX} * ${mycount} else @ mycount = ${base} @ mystart = ( ${rem} * ( ${base} + 1 ) ) + ( ( ${JOBINDEX} - ${rem} ) * ${base} ) endif
@ line_start = ${mystart} + 1 @ line_end = ${mystart} + ${mycount}
echo "========================================" echo "JOBINDEX = ${JOBINDEX}" echo "Total files = ${NTOTAL}, total jobs = ${NJOBS}" echo "This job's files: lines ${line_start}-${line_end} (${mycount} files)" echo "========================================"
if ( ${mycount} == 0 ) then echo "No files assigned to this job (nProcesses exceeds file count); nothing to do." exit 0 endif
sed -n "${line_start},${line_end}p" {{LISTFILE}} > my_lines.list
# Fetch each assigned file (xrdcp for xrootd URLs, cp otherwise); # strip the trailing event-count column MakeRunList.pl appends. set xrdname = "root://xrdstar.rcf.bnl.gov:1095" set xrdnchar = `echo $xrdname | awk '{print length($0)}'`
rm -f simpletree_files.list touch simpletree_files.list
# Needed so the NBEFORE/NAFTER glob below (0 matches on the first # iteration) expands to nothing instead of aborting with "No match." set nonomatch
set i = 1 while ( ${i} <= ${mycount} ) set RAWLINE = `sed -n "${i}p" my_lines.list` set FILEURL = `echo ${RAWLINE} | rev | cut -d'/' -f2- | rev` set LOCALFILE = `basename ${FILEURL}`
echo "----------------------------------------" echo "File ${i}/${mycount}: ${FILEURL}" echo "----------------------------------------"
set urlprefix = `echo ${FILEURL} | awk -v l="$xrdnchar" '{print substr($0,0,l)}'`
if ( "$xrdname" == "$urlprefix" ) then xrdcp --retry 3 ${FILEURL} ${LOCALFILE} else cp ${FILEURL} ${LOCALFILE} endif
if ( ! -f ${LOCALFILE} ) then echo "ERROR: could not obtain input file ${FILEURL}, skipping" @ i++ continue endif if ( -z ${LOCALFILE} ) then echo "ERROR: input file ${LOCALFILE} has zero size, skipping" rm -f ${LOCALFILE} @ i++ continue endif
set NBEFORE = `ls SimpleTree_mudst_*.root | grep -c '\.root$'`
echo "Running runMudst.C..." root4star -b -q runMudst.C\(\"${LOCALFILE}\",-1,-2,\".\",1,0\)
rm -f ${LOCALFILE}
# Require a NEW file, not just "ls -t | head -1" finding one -- # that silently re-picks up a stale prior-iteration file when # runMudst.C fails without crashing, causing a phantom duplicate. set NAFTER = `ls SimpleTree_mudst_*.root | grep -c '\.root$'` if ( ${NAFTER} <= ${NBEFORE} ) then echo "ERROR: runMudst.C produced no NEW output for ${FILEURL} (SimpleTree count stayed at ${NBEFORE}), skipping" @ i++ continue endif
set SIMPLETREE = `ls -t SimpleTree_mudst_*.root | head -1` echo "Produced: ${SIMPLETREE}" echo "${SIMPLETREE}" >> simpletree_files.list
@ i++ end
set NPRODUCED = `wc -l < simpletree_files.list` echo "Produced ${NPRODUCED}/${mycount} SimpleTree files for this job"
if ( ${NPRODUCED} == 0 ) then echo "ERROR: no SimpleTree files produced; nothing to jet-find" exit 1 endif
# Jet finding: one RecoJets call per SimpleTree file, output named with matching suffix. module purge module load fastjet-3.3.4 module load root-5.34.38
echo "Compiling RecoJets..." g++ -m64 RecoJets.cpp VectorDict.cxx -o RecoJets \ `root-config --cflags --libs` \ `fastjet-config --cxxflags --libs` -std=c++11
set TRIGGER_FILTER = "{{TRIGGER_FILTER}}"
set j = 1 while ( ${j} <= ${NPRODUCED} ) set STFILE = `sed -n "${j}p" simpletree_files.list` set SUFFIX = `echo ${STFILE} | sed -e 's/^SimpleTree_mudst_//' -e 's/\.root$//'`
echo "----------------------------------------" echo "Jet finding ${j}/${NPRODUCED}: ${STFILE} -> jet_output_${SUFFIX}.root" echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "${STFILE}" >! single_file.list ./RecoJets single_file.list "${TRIGGER_FILTER}" mv jet_output.root jet_output_${SUFFIX}.root
@ j++ end
if ( {{SAVE_SIMPLETREE}} == 0 ) then foreach f ( `cat simpletree_files.list` ) rm -f ${f} end endif
# Temporary, job-local only; never meant to leave scratch. rm -f my_lines.list simpletree_files.list single_file.list
echo "Files in scratch:" ls -l
